evidence.quote: While we believe that our policy rate is likely at or near its peak for this tightening cycle
the question of when will it become appropriate to begin dialing back the amount of policy restraint in place, that, that begins to come into view
So we're, we're aware of the risk that we would hang on too long. You know, we know that that's a risk, and we're very focused on not making that mistake.
The lower inflation readings over the past several months are welcome, but we will need to see further evidence to build confidence that inflation is moving down sustainably toward our goal.
We're, we're not talking about altering the pace of QT right now, just to get that out of the way.
Today, we decided to leave our policy interest rate unchanged and to continue to reduce our securities holdings.
